about: The ONLY file that carries the system's display name. Every path, env var, database
file and declaration key uses the internal codename `ea` instead, so renaming the
system at handover is: edit system_name here, rename .claude/commands/NAME.md,
rename the folder (and repo_root below), and one find-and-replace for NAME across *.md.
Nothing in scripts/ or .claude/hooks/ carries the display name.
system_name_status: placeholder until Taylor names the system at handover
repo_root_note: Build location on Mike's machine. At handover this becomes C:\<Name>, never a path under Documents or Desktop.
timezone_status: assumed from YYZ; Taylor has not confirmed it (blueprint s.11 asks for it to be verified)
